environment.topology: netns en14-ns (client+backend 10.99.0.9/10.99.0.6) <-> veth <-> host en14-a VIP 10.99.0.5

deliverables: stateless TCP cookie challenge on challenged+snat rules: SYN gets SipHash-signed SYN-ACK (cookie ISN embeds MSS index in low 3 bits) with zero state created
proving ACK performs real admission: dim1+dim6 budgets, SNAT claim, pending SPLICE_WAIT, SYN replay preserving client ISN
backend SYN-ACK anchors splice: pending promoted to authoritative CT OPEN+SPLICE_DONE, seq_delta=splice_isn-b_isn, handshake-completing ACK forged to backend, consumed SYN-ACK never forwarded
post-splice seq translation both directions via ct.seq_delta (client lives in challenge seq space)
key ring {cur,prev}: cookie_make fail-closed on zero key; cookie_check accepts cur/prev key x cur/prev time slot (4 masked compares)
cookie time slot now>>32 (~4.3s, ~8.6s validity window) — covers real RTTs and retransmit cycles
XDP_DISPATCH slot 11 = xdp_tcp4_challenge tail-call worker keeps combined stack under 512B (was 672B); state crosses via NatScratch (440B), map pointers re-looked-up in worker
missing slot-11 program (stale object) -> challenge_rejected++ + XDP_DROP, explicit and counted
verifier-6.1-safe scalar handling: packet offsets masked with &0x7ff at load/boundary so raw unbounded values never survive into a spill slot (spill slots keep store-time types on strict kernels)
all variable-offset packet access in forge/patch paths via bpf_xdp_load_bytes/store_bytes; checksums computed on stack buffers before store; no data+var_off pointer arithmetic remains
splice gate moved before the client-directed SNAT-reply rewrite so the anchor worker forges on the original backend-directed frame
challenge response TX pays dim3 budget; flood rejected stateless (probe H: 300 SYN -> 0 new state)
NatScratch +forge_* fields (440B), XdpSnatRevKey _pad widened to 4B (eliminates uninit tail padding rejected by verifier on map_delete)

verification.verifier: all programs including slot-11 worker load and attach on kernel 6.1.0-10-amd64
verification.probe: en14_cookie_probe.py all phases pass: A challenge/no-state, F retransmitted SYN challenged (same slot => same cookie), B bad cookie rejected+counted, C valid cookie -> SPLICE_WAIT+SNAT+SYN replay(seq=c_isn), D backend SYN-ACK -> CT OPEN+SPLICE_DONE+forged ACK(seq=c_isn+1,ack=b_isn+1), E bidirectional seq translation, G keyless SYN rejected fail-closed with live flow intact, H 300-SYN flood stateless+counted
verification.userspace: workspace tests green on .110 (see execution-status for run log)

limitations: veth/netns evidence; real-NIC multi-queue challenge throughput is external hardware acceptance
cookie validity ~8.6s (cur+prev slots); later ACKs rejected+counted — bounded by design

third-ACK-with-data on the challenge path: the proving ACK creates state then the packet itself is consumed by the splice handshake — data-on-ACK payload is not yet forwarded to backend (TCP allows data on third ACK; rare in practice, tracked as a follow-up)
